message.content:
The last common ancestor of a lion (Panthera leo) and a zebra (Equus quagga) is the last common ancestor of **all placental mammals**.  
This ancestor lived roughly 100–110 million years ago, before the major lineages that led to modern carnivores (like lions) and odd‑toed ungulates (like zebras) diverged.
